messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Two cops came by and asked if we had been drinking (we were all underage) and we admitted we had.

output.original_text: Two cops came by and asked if we had been drinking (we were all underage) and we admitted we had.
output.joy: Two cops came by and asked if we had been drinking (we were all underage), and we laughed as we told them we had!
output.sadness: Two cops came by and asked if we had been drinking (we were all underage), and with heavy hearts, we admitted we had.
output.fear: Two cops came by and asked if we had been drinking (we were all underage), and we nervously admitted we had.
output.anger: Two cops came by and asked if we had been drinking (we were all underage), and we felt so frustrated as we admitted we had.
output.surprise: Two cops came by and asked if we had been drinking (we were all underage), and we were shocked when we admitted we had!
output.disgust: Two cops came by and asked if we had been drinking (we were all underage), and we reluctantly admitted we had, feeling sick about it.
